cues.text: The summer festival at Naganaki Shrine, lined with stalls and crowded with people. You arrive with Mitsuru and Aigis.
Aigis turns and heads straight for a takoyaki stall, where a vendor is cooking. You and Mitsuru follow her. Aigis bites into a takoyaki.
The three of you move on to a stall selling masks.
Further along, you come to a lucky-draw stall. You take your turn and draw a ticket.
